⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. generate (v)
/ˈdʒenəreɪt/
sản xuất, tạo ra (điện năng, nhiệt năng, năng lượng sạch)
Collocation: generate electricity, generate clean power, generate heat
"Giant offshore wind farms can generate enough clean electricity to power half a million homes."
2. turbine (n)
/ˈtɜːbaɪn/
tua-bin (cánh quạt quay bằng sức gió, hơi nước hoặc sức nước để phát điện)
Collocation: wind turbine, steam turbine, spin the turbine blades
"High-pressure steam is forced through a chamber to spin the turbine at high speed."
3. solar (adj)
/ˈsəʊlə(r)/
thuộc về mặt trời (năng lượng mặt trời)
Collocation: solar panels, solar power, solar radiation
"Rooftop solar panels absorb sunlight during the day and turn it into electrical current."
4. convert (v)
/kənˈvɜːt/
chuyển đổi, biến đổi (từ dạng năng lượng/vật chất này sang dạng khác)
Collocation: convert A into B, be converted into electricity
"In the fourth stage, a generator converts mechanical motion into alternating electrical current."
5. transmit (v)
/trænzˈmɪt/
truyền tải (điện năng hoặc tín hiệu đi xa qua đường dây cáp)
Collocation: transmit high-voltage power, be transmitted via cables
"Once the voltage is stepped up, electricity is transmitted across long distances through overhead cables."
6. grid (n)
/ɡrɪd/
mạng lưới điện quốc gia
Collocation: national electricity grid, feed power into the grid
"Any surplus electricity produced by the plant is fed directly into the national power grid."
7. stage (n)
/steɪdʒ/
giai đoạn, bước (từ khóa trụ cột trong IELTS Writing Task 1 Process)
Collocation: at the initial stage, a five-stage process, in the final stage
"Overall, the diagram illustrates a continuous process consisting of five main stages."
8. subsequently (adv)
/ˈsʌbsɪkwəntli/
sau đó, tiếp theo đó (trạng từ nối C1 thay thế cho 'Then / Next' trong Task 1 Process)
Collocation: Subsequently, the mixture is heated / be subsequently cooled
"The cold water is heated by underground rocks and subsequently pumped back up to the surface."
9. initial (adj)
/ɪˈnɪʃl/
ban đầu, đầu tiên
Collocation: at the initial stage, initial phase, initial investment
"At the initial stage of the process, cold water is pumped deep underground through an injection well."
10. undergo (v)
/ˌʌndəˈɡəʊ/
trải qua (một quá trình xử lý, lọc, đun nóng hoặc biến đổi — KHÔNG chia bị động)
Collocation: undergo filtration, undergo chemical treatment, undergo heating
"Before being bottled, the recycled liquid must undergo a strict purification process."
11. filter (v/n)
/ˈfɪltə(r)/
lọc sạch tạp chất; bộ lọc, màng lọc
Collocation: filter out impurities, pass through a fine sand filter
"First, the raw water passes through a fine screen in order to filter out solid waste."
12. extract (v)
/ɪkˈstrækt/
khai thác, rút/chiết xuất ra (nhiệt năng, khoáng sản, nguyên liệu thô)
Collocation: extract natural heat, extract raw materials from the ground
"Geothermal plants extract intense thermal energy from deep beneath the Earth's crust."
13. distribute (v)
/dɪˈstrɪbjuːt/
phân phối, cung cấp (điện năng/hàng hóa đến hộ gia đình và nhà máy)
Collocation: distribute electricity to homes, be distributed to retailers
"At the final stage, clean power is distributed to domestic households and factories."
14. apparatus (n)
/ˌæpəˈreɪtəs/
thiết bị, hệ thống máy móc chuyên dụng (không đếm được hoặc số ít)
Collocation: condensing apparatus, cooling apparatus, laboratory apparatus
"The hot water enters a specialized condensing apparatus, where it turns into high-pressure steam."
15. continuous (adj)
/kənˈtɪnjuəs/
liên tục, khép kín không ngừng nghỉ
Collocation: a continuous cycle, continuous power supply
"Unlike solar power, geothermal energy provides a continuous supply of electricity day and night."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Thể Bị Động Hiện Tại Đơn (Present Simple Passive: is/are + V3/ed) — Trụ Cột Task 1 Process

• Tại sao bài Process bắt buộc dùng Bị động? Trong sơ đồ quy trình sản xuất (Man-made Process), người ta quan tâm nguyên liệu/nước/điện được xử lý như thế nào chứ không quan tâm ai làm. Do đó, 80% câu phải chia S + is / are + V3/ed.

• Công thức chuẩn theo từng bước:
  1. At the initial stage, cold water is pumped 4.5 km underground.
  2. Next, solid impurities are filtered out using a fine screen.
  3. Mechanical motion is converted into electricity by a generator.
  4. Finally, power is transmitted to the national grid and distributed to homes.

• Bẫy động từ KHÔNG chia bị động: Động từ undergo (trải qua) và consist of (bao gồm) luôn chia chủ động:
  Ví dụ: The cold water undergoes intense heating. / A continuous process consisting of five stages.

🔵 Tầng 2: Liên Từ Phân Tầng Giai Đoạn (Sequencing Connectors) — Xóa Bỏ Lỗi Lặp 'First, Then, Next'

• Hệ thống từ nối tuần tự đạt Band 7.0 Coherence & Cohesion:
  - Mở đầu quy trình: At the initial stage of the process, ... / The process begins when ...
  - Nối 2 bước liên hoàn bằng Once + S + has/have been V3/ed:
    Ví dụ: Once the water has been heated by hot rocks, it is extracted to the surface.
  - Bước tiếp theo trang trọng: Subsequently, ... / Following this, ... / In the subsequent stage, ...
  - Kết thúc quy trình: In the final stage, ... / The process culminates in ...

2. High-pressure steam is directed into a chamber to spin the blades of a heavy-duty ________.
3. Many homeowners are installing rooftop ________ panels to reduce their monthly electricity bills.
4. Inside the powerhouse, mechanical energy from the spinning shaft is ________ into electrical current.
5. High-voltage electricity is ________ across the country through a network of overhead cables.
6. Any surplus power produced by the plant is fed directly into the national electricity ________.
7. Overall, the diagram illustrates a linear manufacturing process consisting of six distinct ________.
8. The recycled glass is crushed into powder and ________ melted in a high-temperature furnace.
9. At the ________ stage of the geothermal process, cold water is pumped 4.5 km underground.
10. Before entering the storage tank, the recycled water must ________ strict chemical filtration.
11. Raw water passes through a fine carbon screen in order to ________ out solid impurities.
12. In geothermal plants, intense thermal heat is ________ from deep beneath the Earth's crust.
13. At the end of the process, electricity is ________ to domestic households and industrial factories.

19. [Ôn tập Unit 14] Renewable energy accounted for the largest ________ of new power investment in 2025.

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Advantage of Continuous Geothermal Power]
As nations strive to replace fossil fuels, renewable energy sources such as rooftop solar panels and offshore wind farms have expanded rapidly. However, both sunlight and wind suffer from intermittency: when the sun sets or the wind drops, electricity production falls sharply. Geothermal energy, by contrast, offers a reliable and continuous supply of clean power twenty-four hours a day by tapping into the immense thermal energy stored beneath the Earth's crust to generate electricity.

[Paragraph B - Underground Injection and Geothermal Heating (Stages 1 - 2)]
The production of geothermal power follows a closed-loop five-stage process. At the initial stage, cold water stored in a surface tank passes through a fine screen to filter out solid sediments. This clean water is then pumped down an injection well to a depth of 4.5 kilometres. Deep underground, the cold water undergoes intense heating as it flows through a geothermal zone of fractured, superheated rocks.

[Paragraph C - Steam Extraction, Turbine Rotation and Grid Transmission (Stages 3 - 5)]
Once the water has been superheated, it is extracted back up to the surface via a production well and enters a specialized condensing apparatus, where it turns into high-pressure steam. Subsequently, this steam forces a heavy-duty turbine to spin at high speed. The rotating turbine drives an electrical generator, which converts mechanical motion into electrical current. In the final stage, the electricity is stepped up by a transformer and transmitted via overhead cables to the national grid to be distributed to domestic homes.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (IELTS Task 1: Process Diagram): Quy Trình Sản Xuất Điện Địa Nhiệt (5 Stages)

Đề bài: The diagram illustrates the five-stage process of how geothermal energy is used to generate electricity: [Stage 1: Cold water filtered & pumped 4.5km down Injection Well] -> [Stage 2: Water undergoes heating through Hot Rocks in Geothermal Zone] -> [Stage 3: Superheated water extracted up Production Well into Condensing Apparatus to become steam] -> [Stage 4: High-pressure steam spins Turbine & Generator converts mechanical energy into electricity] -> [Stage 5: Electricity transmitted via cables to National Grid & distributed to homes]. Summarize the main stages of the process (90 - 120 words).

Tiêu chuẩn Task 1 Process: Có câu Overview nêu tổng số bước (a continuous process consisting of five main stages), dùng ít nhất 3 động từ Bị động Hiện tại đơn (is pumped, is extracted, is converted, is transmitted), liên từ phân tầng (At the initial stage, Once..., Subsequently, In the final stage) và ít nhất 6 từ vựng Unit 17.
